$ state.py --help
exit 0
--- stdout
usage: state.py [-h] [--root ROOT] [--runtime {claude,codex}] {step-done,ask,answer,questions,handoff,profile,weight,event,approve,reject,close,start,steps,batch,verify,review,status,decision,consent,recall,memory} ...

Task state for /rr-build — the small, machine-readable record of one task.

positional arguments:
  {step-done,ask,answer,questions,handoff,profile,weight,event,approve,reject,close,start,steps,batch,verify,review,status,decision,consent,recall,memory}
    recall              what the record holds about these files, within a
                        token budget
    memory              the compact project record (docs/local-memory.md)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           project directory (default: search upwards for .ai/)
  --runtime {claude,codex}
                        overrides AI_RUNTIME and detection for this call
--- stderr

options:

  --force     accepted for older callers; it forces nothing
--- stderr

$ state.py start --help
exit 0
--- stdout
usage: state.py start [-h] [--goal GOAL] [--workflow WORKFLOW] [--files FILES] [--tests TESTS] [--declare DECLARE] [--mode MODE] [--by BY] [--why WHY] [--steps STEPS] [--plan-file PLAN_FILE] [--task-id TASK_ID] [--slug SLUG] [--amend] [--batch] [--no-batch]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --goal GOAL
  --workflow WORKFLOW
  --files FILES
  --tests TESTS
  --declare DECLARE
  --mode MODE
  --by BY
  --why WHY
  --steps STEPS
  --plan-file PLAN_FILE
  --task-id TASK_ID     an id of your own; a legacy T-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN id is
                        still accepted
  --slug SLUG           3-24 characters of [a-z0-9] words joined by '-': the
                        id becomes T-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-<slug> (UTC). Default:
                        derived from --goal
  --amend
  --batch               the batch loop of /rr-build-all (needs --by)
  --no-batch            opt out of weight.json batch.default
--- stderr
